import json
mem = currentProgram.getMemory()
def hexdump(addr, n):
    a = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress(addr)
    b = mem.getBytes(a, n)
    return " ".join("%02x" % (x & 0xff) for x in b)
print(json.dumps({"03b0": hexdump("140af03b0", 48), "01f0_dispatch": hexdump("140aef1f0", 16)}))
